explanation: Try lengths one through three for the first three segments. Validate all four resulting parts as values 0 through 255 with no multi-digit leading zero, then insert dots into each valid partition.
timeComplexity: O(n) safe upper-bound time for input length n with a fixed number of segment-length choices, plus output characters.
